mapper.sql: r.id AS revision_id, r.version_id, v.material_id, m.owner_type, m.owner_key, r.fence_generation AS revision_fence_generation, m.lifecycle_generation AS material_lifecycle_generation, r.fingerprint AS processing_fingerprint, manifest.object_key AS retrieval_manifest_key, manifest.object_version_id AS retrieval_manifest_version_id, manifest.content_sha256 AS retrieval_manifest_sha256, manifest.byte_size AS retrieval_manifest_size, manifest.content_type AS retrieval_manifest_content_type
mapper.select: SELECT FROM material_processing_revision r JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id JOIN material_revision_artifact manifest ON manifest.revision_id = r.id AND manifest.artifact_kind = 'RETRIEVAL_MANIFEST' JOIN material_processing_job j ON j.revision_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{revisionId} AND r.state = 'PROCESSING' AND r.stage = 'INDEXING' AND r.progress = 93 AND v.ingest_state = 'PROCESSING' AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND j.id = #{jobId} AND j.stage = 'BUILD_LEXICAL_PROJECTION' AND j.work_key = 'root' AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.sql: , g.id AS index_generation_id, g.index_name, g.namespace, g.embedding_model, g.embedding_model_fingerprint, g.dimension, g.metric, g.vector_schema_version, rv.tokenizer_fingerprint, b.batch_no, b.work_key, b.input_fingerprint AS batch_input_fingerprint, b.vector_object_key, b.vector_object_version_id, b.vector_content_sha256, b.vector_byte_size, b.vector_content_type
mapper.select: SELECT FROM material_processing_revision r JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id JOIN material_revision_artifact manifest ON manifest.revision_id = r.id AND manifest.artifact_kind = 'RETRIEVAL_MANIFEST' JOIN retrieval_vector_batch b ON b.revision_id = r.id AND b.work_key = #{workKey} JOIN rag_index_generation g ON g.id = b.index_generation_id JOIN retrieval_revision_vector_projection rv ON rv.revision_id = r.id AND rv.index_generation_id = g.id JOIN material_processing_job j ON j.revision_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{revisionId} AND r.state = 'PROCESSING' AND r.stage = 'INDEXING' AND b.state = 'PENDING' AND v.ingest_state = 'PROCESSING' AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND j.id = #{jobId} AND j.stage = 'EMBED_CHUNK_BATCHES' AND j.work_key = b.work_key AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

SELECT FROM material_processing_revision r JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id JOIN material_revision_artifact manifest ON manifest.revision_id = r.id AND manifest.artifact_kind = 'RETRIEVAL_MANIFEST' JOIN retrieval_vector_batch b ON b.revision_id = r.id AND b.work_key = #{workKey} JOIN rag_index_generation g ON g.id = b.index_generation_id JOIN retrieval_revision_vector_projection rv ON rv.revision_id = r.id AND rv.index_generation_id = g.id JOIN material_processing_job j ON j.revision_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{revisionId} AND r.state = 'PROCESSING' AND r.stage = 'INDEXING' AND b.state = 'EMBEDDED' AND v.ingest_state = 'PROCESSING' AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND j.id = #{jobId} AND j.stage = 'UPSERT_VECTOR_BATCHES' AND j.work_key = b.work_key AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

SELECT p.retrieval_chunk_id AS chunk_id, p.vector_id, p.embedding_fingerprint AS projection_fingerprint, c.chunk_type, c.modality, page.page_no, c.language_primary AS language FROM retrieval_chunk_vector_projection p JOIN retrieval_chunk c ON c.id = p.retrieval_chunk_id LEFT JOIN material_page page ON page.id = c.page_id AND page.revision_id = c.revision_id WHERE c.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND p.index_generation_id = #{generationId} AND p.batch_no = #{batchNo} AND p.state = 'EMBEDDED' ORDER BY c.structural_ordinal, c.id

SELECT , g.id AS index_generation_id, g.index_name, g.namespace, g.embedding_model, g.embedding_model_fingerprint, g.dimension, g.metric, g.vector_schema_version, rv.tokenizer_fingerprint, rv.projection_role, p.retrieval_chunk_id AS chunk_id, p.vector_id, p.embedding_fingerprint AS projection_fingerprint, rv.expected_projection_count AS eligible_projection_count FROM material_processing_revision r JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id JOIN material_revision_artifact manifest ON manifest.revision_id = r.id AND manifest.artifact_kind = 'RETRIEVAL_MANIFEST' JOIN rag_index_generation g ON CONCAT('ig:', g.id) = #{workKey} JOIN retrieval_revision_vector_projection rv ON rv.revision_id = r.id AND rv.index_generation_id = g.id LEFT JOIN retrieval_chunk c ON c.revision_id = r.id LEFT JOIN retrieval_chunk_vector_projection p ON p.retrieval_chunk_id = c.id AND p.index_generation_id = g.id AND p.state = 'INDEXED' JOIN material_processing_job j ON j.revision_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{revisionId} AND r.state = 'PROCESSING' AND r.stage = 'INDEXING' AND j.id = #{jobId} AND j.stage = 'VERIFY_PROJECTION_MANIFEST' AND j.work_key = #{workKey} AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND v.ingest_state = 'PROCESSING' AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retrieval_vector_batch pending WHERE pending.revision_id = r.id AND pending.index_generation_id = g.id AND pending.state != 'INDEXED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retrieval_chunk_vector_projection pending_projection JOIN retrieval_chunk projected_chunk ON projected_chunk.id = pending_projection.retrieval_chunk_id WHERE projected_chunk.revision_id = r.id AND pending_projection.index_generation_id = g.id AND pending_projection.state != 'INDEXED') ORDER BY p.retrieval_chunk_id
SELECT * FROM retrieval_revision_vector_projection WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND index_generation_id = #{generationId}
SELECT * FROM retrieval_vector_batch WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND index_generation_id = #{generationId} AND batch_no = #{batchNo}
SELECT * FROM retrieval_chunk_vector_projection WHERE retrieval_chunk_id = #{chunkId} AND index_generation_id = #{generationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE retrieval_vector_batch SET vector_object_key = #{objectKey}, vector_object_version_id = #{objectVersionId}, vector_content_sha256 = #{contentSha256}, vector_byte_size = #{byteSize}, vector_content_type = #{contentType}, state = 'EMBEDDED' WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND index_generation_id = #{generationId} AND batch_no = #{batchNo} AND state = 'PENDING'
